formulas.ascii: Per label group g over the rows with a finite position and a label below groupCount: n_g = rows in g, mean center = sum p_i / n_g, bounds = exact min and max of x and y, medoid = the row i minimizing D_i = sum over rows j of g of |p_i - p_j| (lowest row on ties; groups over medoidMaximumGroupSize get no medoid). The standard distance and the standard deviational ellipse come from GPUGeographicDistribution on the same groups. Sums are fixed-order, so results are reproducible.
y[i] = sum(x[s(i)..i-1+delta]) mod 2^32; delta=0 exclusive (default), 1 inclusive; s(i) is the last nonzero segment flag or 0.
offsets[i] = sum(flags[0..i-1]) mod 2^32; count = offsets[n-1]+flags[n-1] mod 2^32, or 0 when empty. Flags are raw uint32 values.
y[s]=sum|min|max of x[offsets[s]..offsets[s+1]-1], empty=0; no mask or nonfinite filter. Min/max fold from type extrema (finite f32 extrema); integer sums wrap at 32 bits.
